title: The FotMob TOTW for the Premier League: MD10’s Best XI featuring Ngumoha, Wirtz, and Okafor
subtitle: FotMob
paragraphs: NewsAboutThe FotMob TOTW for the Premier League: MD10’s Best XI featuring Ngumoha, Wirtz, and OkaforShareThe latest round of Premier League fixtures is complete, with Arsenal establishing a six-point lead at the top of the table.
Brighton and Manchester City are the challengers, while Leeds and Brentford are pushing for European spots.
Elsewhere, Manchester United dropped to 19th in the table after yet another loss. New manager Mauricio Pochettino has a massive task on his hands.

Hull sealed a superb 2-0 win over Brighton on Sunday thanks to a late brace from Oli McBurnie. It was the heroics of Konstantinos Tzolakis, however, which prevented the league's highest scoring team from adding to their impressive tally this season.
Indeed, the Greek shot-stopper made seven saves during the tie and even showed his willingness to build play from the back by taking 53 touches. He is proving to be an inspired signing by the Tigers.
Tottenham Hotspur continued their fine form with a straightforward 2-0 win over Ipswich. Defender Pedro Porro played well and he makes the Team of the Week (TOTW) for the first time this season.
The Spaniard contributed well from an attacking point of view, providing an assist, along with generating two chances and making 19 passes into the final third.
Defensively, he won 75% of his ground duels and committed just one foul. As such, Porro receives an 8.3 match rating.

Leeds secured their first victory at Stamford Bridge for 27 years over the weekend. While Daniel Farke’s side were incredible in the final third, it was the defence which ensured the game was easier than it should have been.
James Justin was a rock at centre-back. He made 11 defensive contributions overall, including five tackles, and three interceptions.
Not only that, but Justin covered the most ground out of anyone on the pitch (12.5km) as his relentless pressing helped Leeds repel Chelsea even into the dying minutes.
Remarkably, this will be James Hill’s third inclusion in the TOTW after just 11 rounds of matches.
His recent performance was yet more proof of how important he will be for the Cherries this term.
Hill was a constant presence on the ball, taking the most touches of anyone on the pitch (86), while he also recorded 14 defensive contribution, including 11 clearances.
The centre-back even won 100% of his ground duels as Nottingham Forest players simply couldn’t find a way to get round him. He is more than deserving of a 8.5 rating.
Brentford eased to a 4-0 win against Everton on Monday evening and Keane Lewis-Potter kicked things off with two goals in two minutes.
The left-back was a menace throughout the game, creating two chances also and taking eight touches in the opposition penalty box.
Lewis-Potter even won 100% of his aerial duels and succeeded with 88% of his passes in what was a wonderful all-round performance. His 9.1 rating is the highest out of the defenders this week.
🤯 Keane Lewis-Potter has just scored a three-minute brace for Brentford! pic.twitter.com/WLcsRUO6ZL
Noni Madueke started just one of Arsenal’s first six Premier League matches, but since scoring the winner against Forest a few weeks ago, he hasn’t left the starting XI.
